byInvariant.description: Increasing monthly income, all else equal, must not reduce monthly surplus.
byInvariant.assumption: Delta is non-negative and no other input changes.

byInvariant.description: Increasing monthly expenses, all else equal, must not increase monthly surplus.
byInvariant.assumption: Delta is non-negative. When EMI is included in expenses, expenses remain the outflow base.

byInvariant.description: Increasing accessible savings, all else equal, must not reduce living-expense coverage.
byInvariant.assumption: Applies only when monthly living expenses are positive; coverage is undefined when E = 0.

byInvariant.description: Increasing the one-time unexpected expense, all else equal, must not increase post-shock savings.
byInvariant.assumption: The shock is applied once to accessible savings and never to monthly surplus.

byInvariant.description: Increasing a positive goal contribution must not increase the projected months to an unfunded goal.
byInvariant.assumption: Applies only when a target amount is set. An unreachable goal (no positive contribution) is treated as infinite months.

byInvariant.description: When EMI is already included in expenses, increasing EMI must not change outflows or surplus.
byInvariant.assumption: Applies only when emiIncludedInExpenses is true, because EMI is already inside E.

byInvariant.description: When EMI is paid separately, increasing EMI must not increase monthly surplus.
byInvariant.assumption: Applies only when emiIncludedInExpenses is false, because EMI is then added to O.
